summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric multiplayer action RPG, with a shared main realm for the Wayside Fire, Broken Lantern Road, Candlehold and later areas, plus a solo Veil title/menu place. Player and place/boss handlers own combat and progression; character/data modules provide persistence and shared services, while procedural scenes, texture assets and catalogued models build the world.
places: places/main/ - shared playable realm: Wayside Fire hub, Broken Lantern Road quest route, Bailiff arena, Candlehold and later chapter areas; places/main/sim.js places enemy packs including Tallow Chandler (mb1) before the Dripping Gate and Hollow Cantor (mb2) among the choristers, alongside Ossuary encounters.
places/veil/ - solo ephemeral title/menu stage and ravine backdrop, the world default place; player is parked here while menus are active and Enter transitions to main.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: defaultPlace veil; attaches player/camera templates, lighting, arrival/nametag behaviors, controls and audio mix; C/N map to sheet/tree.
templates/player.js - player body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - main-place referee for hub NPCs/services, quests, enemy packs, progression, boss lifecycle/reset and soundscape.

places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - shared realm atmosphere, terrain materials and authored settlements, services, landmarks and encounters; terrain texture assets are registered in world.assets.yaml.
places/veil/config.yaml and places/veil/cells/ - solo title/menu scene and ambience; scripts/arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival reuse it, crier and board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm/character and trade schemas plus realm routing/name registry; db.js also creates guild_vault rows/index.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - combat, skill, enemy and boss parameters consumed by player, place sim, wax-pack and pack UI; includes Tallow Chandler and Hollow Cantor profiles.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT and body map shared model IDs to uploaded enemy/character GLBs and true heights; places/main/sim.js and scripts/wax-pack.js reuse it.
scripts/lib/data/talents.js - per-calling tree definitions, point/rank gates and talent-to-stat calculation; player and HUD share it.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml with scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denominations, drops, rewards, sale values and stock shared by sim, combat, shop, HUD and crier.
scripts/lib/data/loot.yml, loot-icons.yml and scripts/lib/loot.js - gear/drop/forge rules, rolls, smith ranks, boss marks, crafting and gear stats for combat, pack UI and trade.
scripts/lib/data/trade.yml and scripts/lib/trade.js - realm listing/buy/unlist/collection logic and shared listing reads for Wayside/Candlehold boards, crier and board-notes.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, boltLand, crosswoundFall, update; delayed projectile impacts and Crosswound cleave dispatch to their handlers.
scripts/camera.js - onInput, update; scripts/sway.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn, update.
scripts/ui.js - state-driven HUD/menu/sheet/talent-tree renderer, unit frames and version 0.13.1 notes/foe portraits; scripts/ui/nametag.js - nametag renderer.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js and hangman.js - boss onSpawn/update handlers.
scripts/crier.js - onSpawn, quiet, update; scripts/board-notes.js and scripts/trophies.js - update; scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, roster, create/load/save/remove; persistent vault, vaultRows and talents are Bearer fields.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body; scripts/lib/data/talents.js - talent tree/stat helpers; scripts/lib/trade.js - TRADE and board/input helpers.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent per-Bearer combat/progression, quest and reward claims, inventory/gear, arts, attuned shrines, personal vault/vaultRows and talents; packed position and zone feed re-entry/menu context.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement/combat/death, class basic attacks and skill timers, menu/options scratch, floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; proximity flags and service reads are transient body state.
scripts/player.js - writes transient hurtAt when hp drops, consumed by scripts/ui.js for the red portrait-hit flash.
places/main/sim.js - quest/dialog/cut progress and reward claims; hub NPC/service spawning; enemy pack and boss lifecycle/reset, respawn rows and room music/ambience.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary and mini-boss enemy AI/hp/casts/death, one-time half-health summons, and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.
scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat, participant flags and place boss rows/lastFall.
Boss scripts - first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] record {at, by}; scripts/trophies.js derives relic visibility, plaque/stele text and transient ring/flash dedupe.
scripts/lib/guildvault.js and guild_vault SQL rows - shared stored items keyed by realm and Spawn guild; guarded take marks taken_at/taken_by, while character inventory owns the member's copy.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → scripts/player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options/notes.

world.config.yaml defaultPlace veil → player loads into the Veil title screen; player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil; menu screens remain state-driven and that place has no characters.
scripts/ui.js reads selected roster character zone to choose the painted menu backdrop; zoneArt maps zone names to menu artwork.

controls.js selects menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu active and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies world controls; ui.js actions return to player.js and service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary access depends on stage/open-all and Abbey/Nave access.

Main sim advances quests and spawns/resets bosses; boss defeats mark participants and write place.state.lastFall {boss, by, at} → crier heralds falls; boss scripts write first world.state.trophies[boss] {at, by} → trophies.js, Stele/Post and nametag marks.

Near Wayside forge, pack-ui craft/temper/reforge/ascend → player.js + loot.js consume materials and update gear; cauldron actions consume recipe resources, save timed brew/renderXp and derive combat bonuses.

Near vaults/boards, player.js proximity state opens personal/guild vault or trade UI; pack-ui → guildvault.js SQL mutations, trade actions → trade.js realm listings; board-ui, crier and board-notes share market reads.
places/main/sim.js PACKS + combat.yml kind profiles + models.js body → enemySpec spawns wax-pack actors; wax-pack reads combat stats and drives AI, respawns, payouts and eligible drops.

Chandler/Cantor combat.yml summon profile and wax-pack half-health handler → three summoned pilgrims/choristers using body(models.js), once per life; wax-pack foe hp/kind/gone → UI target frame, player hurtAt → unit-frame flash, C/N opens sheet/tree and learn actions → player validates/saves talents and recalculates stats.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js; hub-board.js is also Candlehold's exchange-board.

scripts/gen/vf-*.js and vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter and road, arena, Wax Veil approach, ashlar, braziers and Abbey door forms varied by params, dimensions and seed; most share vf-kit.js.

scripts/effects/candles.fx.js - milestone, toll-counter and wagon-lantern clusters; up to five wicks share one flame particle population/draw, smoke from the first wick and one light driven by live flame count.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js with cap-gate.js, cap-house.js and cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate share local-frame helpers; instance dimensions, lighting and seed vary.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.

scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing shares scripts/gen/shapes.js and its wax palette; split gibbet cages render separately at a top pivot.

scripts/plants/ashfern.js, bramble.js and mossoak.js - seeded procedural ash-fern, grave-bramble and dead-oak ground cover; geometry thins by LOD and appearance varies by params; current config uses their main-realm registrations.

scripts/wax-pack.js with combat.yml and models.js - shared wax enemy AI/attack/death/payout varies by kind; Chandler and Cantor add melee/slam and half-health summon patterns. Across updated gen kits and world.assets.yaml, sharper uploaded surface maps replace earlier material textures.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural wax-figure generator; live wax actors use CDN models and no current script or scene calls this generator.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; talents, shrines, vault and vaultRows persist per Bearer, while proximity flags and vault UI reads are transient.

Talent IDs are branch-tier strings b-t; one point is earned per level after 1, each earlier tier requires 3 points spent in that same branch, and tier-four capstones have one rank with fourfold stat value. Reset is currently free.
Talents add to gearStats-compatible keys during scripts/player.js gear derivation; talent changes must invalidate the derived-stat cache alongside gear and active brew changes.

Wayshrine IDs and coordinates in scripts/lib/data/combat.yml must stay aligned with scene IDs/locations; travel costs 10 copper and refuses while an enemy is within 10 m; Abbey destination obeys the player gate.

Personal vault is 18 slots plus up to three purchased rows of nine (costs [5000, 20000, 50000] copper) saved per Bearer; guild vault is 27 shared slots per Spawn guild per realm in SQL, separate from character inventory.

places/main/config.yaml pilgrim-road stone material uses /cdn/value.0061e3151987bd6d9b2a3331d58d9a83b0b6c0b2adaebbfda07cf0d902fa2224.png, registered as the uploaded road image in world.assets.yaml; current ash-dirt and updated material references likewise use uploaded texture assets.
